notes: `upstream` is the base image the extended Dockerfile FROMs — the Isol8 fork (Isol8AI/agent) built from upstream OpenClaw 2026.7.2 (branch off tag v2026.7.2-beta.3 — 7.2 is BETA-ONLY upstream, no stable cut yet) plus the FIVE carried fork patches. Three are re-expressed onto 7.2's rewritten MCP manager (upstream #106359): bundled-MCP shared-runtime-scope (keys the static runtime on (workspaceDir, agentDir, configFingerprint) so sessions reuse one connected runtime — collapses the per-session EFS connect storm), non-blocking tool materialization (peek-then-warm; a cold catalog streams the run on built-ins and warms MCP in the background), and provider-agnostic size-based context pruning (Isol8AI/agent#1). The FOURTH, new in isol8.2, is the native workspace-seed boot hook: `ensureAgentWorkspace` converts an Isol8 sentinel `.openclaw/isol8-setup-seed.json` into native SQLite workspace-setup-state via OpenClaw's own `mergeWorkspaceSetupState`, then deletes the sentinel — so no legacy `workspace-state.json` is ever written and the #1429 "requires migration" brick class is structurally impossible. It is INERT when no sentinel exists (zero behavior change for existing containers), non-throwing (a failure logs and falls through to normal boot), and kill-switched by env `ISOL8_NATIVE_SETUP_SEED=0`. The FIFTH, new in isol8.4 (skips isol8.3, an abandoned OPENCLAW_SQLITE_DIR relocation approach superseded by the nested-mount O6 layout), is the session-store read-failure fix (fork PR #3): `loadGatewaySessionLookupStore` no longer swallows a `session_entries` read error into an empty map — under the 7.2 SQLite lock-contention class a transient throw otherwise resolved every session lookup to "no such session", so `chat.history` returned ok:true with zero messages (byte-identical to a new session — the intermittent "agent forgot everything / start-a-new-conversation over a real transcript" bug) and `chat.send` re-keyed the session, orphaning its transcript. It now throws a typed SessionLookupUnavailableError that chat.history/chat.startup convert to the retryable UNAVAILABLE shape the client history-retry ladder already recovers from; a missing DB stays a non-error (created on first open). The 7.1 compaction aws-sdk-auth cherry-pick (openclaw#103638) was DROPPED — native in beta.3. REQUIRED to build the extended image FROM this fork tag, NOT vanilla ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw: config.py emits mcp.runtimeScope="shared" which only the shared-runtime-scope patch adds to the strict config schema (McpConfigSchema, relocated to zod-schema.root-support.ts in #106359, still `z.strictObject`) — a vanilla 7.2 base crash-loops every MCP owner and (via 7.x's fail-closed startup-migration checkpoint) fails the whole fleet closed. Tag scheme `<upstream-version>-isol8.<n>`. This is a PRIVATE GHCR package, only pulled by the authenticated build-openclaw-image.yml workflow. DEPLOY POSTURE: 7.2 is beta upstream; prod has been on beta by explicit owner acceptance since 2026-07-20. `dev.tag` and `prod.tag` are both `2026.7.2-isol8.4-ba2e7007` — the extended image built from merge ba2e7007b, promoting BOTH envs together by explicit owner decision (prod is the test bed for the OpenCode coding harness). This pin carries three changes over the prior `2026.7.2-isol8.2-e1a8fc1`: (1) the fork base advanced isol8.2 -> isol8.4 (the session-store read-failure fix — see `upstream` above; isol8.3 was skipped), (2) a new Dockerfile layer bakes `opencode-ai@1.18.15` as a global bin — the ACP coding harness `chatgpt_oauth` owners spawn (#1669), and (3) the gogcli go-install path followed its module rename steipete -> openclaw/gogcli (#1680, without which the image build fails). Rollback to `2026.7.2-isol8.2-e1a8fc1` drops the harness binary (a chatgpt_oauth spawn then fails command-not-found — degrades to today's no-harness state) and the session-store fix. `image`/`tag`/`full` are the LEGACY PUBLIC upstream image (ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw): container-stack.ts uses `full` as the bootstrap/unknown-env fallback, pulled by per-user ECS tasks that carry NO registry credentials — so it must stay anonymously pullable and must NOT point at the private fork. `tag` also feeds the OPENCLAW_UPSTREAM_VERSION env-var fallback. `extendedImage` + per-env `dev.tag`/`prod.tag` are the ECR-published extended image deployed to dev and prod. PROMOTION IS MANUAL: build-openclaw-image.yml only READS this file and prints "Bump openclaw-version.json#dev.tag to <tag> in a PR to deploy to dev" to its job summary — it never writes the tags. A green image build therefore ships NOTHING to any container until a human lands a PR flipping these fields (an earlier revision of this note wrongly claimed the workflow re-stamps them, which cost a debugging cycle). STORAGE GATE REMOVED (2026-08-04): the per-env `storage` field is gone and the local-sqlite layout is unconditional, so EVERY tag pinned here MUST be built from a commit containing apps/infra/openclaw/local-sqlite/ — i.e. at or after cda209369 (#1581). A tag older than that has no /usr/local/bin/isol8-local-sqlite-boot.sh and its containers exit 1 on the boot guard. Both envs were promoted to 2026.7.2-isol8.2-18f568c in #1603 for exactly this reason — the prior prod pin (5d9330f, built 2026-08-02) predates the boot chain and would have exit-1'd every prod container on the guard.
